node.title: Re^5: convert encoding
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I am wondering why you are using Dumper() and encode() at all? What happens when you do the following?

use open qw/:std :utf8/; use strict; use Lyo::OSLC::CQ::CM; ... my $client = Lyo::OSLC::CQ::CM->new; ... my $data = $client->oslcWhere(...); print $data;

The documentation of the ->oslcWhere() method of the module [https://github.com/eclipse/lyo.client/blob/master/org.eclipse.lyo.client.perl/Lyo-OSLC/lib/Lyo/OSLC/CQ/CM.pm#L287|Lyo::OSLC::CQ::CM] (which does not appear to be on CPAN; so I hope I've found the right one via googling) says:

The response from the server is returned in XML format.

So in that case I would use an XML parser such as [mod://XML::LibXML] to parse it.
